the black vest adds structure without bulk around the waist, and the black pumps extend the leg line for comfort during long meetings.","deliberate":[{"item":"#148·32","why":"A striped knit in warm khaki adds texture and a touch of color that breaks the monotony while staying within her muted complementary scheme.","finding":"f-o7-6"},{"item":"#449·32","why":"I kept the relaxed vest over the fitted sweater to add layers without adding bulk around the waist, helping create a streamlined look that conceals the belly.","finding":"f-o7-1"},{"item":"#241·06","why":"Black pumps with a heel lift the overall height and balance the proportions created by the wide-leg trousers, and they provide the necessary dark anchor for the outfit.","finding":"f-o7-3"}]},{"id":"o5","caption":"Silk blouse, denim suit jacket and boots","pole":"break","items":["#50·11","#439·31","#280·10","#257·21"],"day":"This outfit relies on the harmony of chocolate and brown tones to create a unified look; this combination creates a sleek silhouette that is professional yet cozy enough for long days.","deliberate":[{"item":"#15·00","why":"The code prefers relaxed tops but scored straight as higher for her body type; the solid black fabric adds visual weight to balance the top-heavy volume and anchors the outfit.","finding":"f-o1-1"},{"item":"#47·33","why":"Her goal is to flatter and conceal, so the structured velvet blazer creates a strong vertical line that elongates the body, essential for flattering her O-shaped figure.","finding":"f-o1-2"},{"item":"#269·14","why":"Loafers with a solid heel are chosen for their ability to balance the silhouette better than flats, and they provide a grounded anchor at the bottom of the column.","finding":"f-o1-3"}]},{"id":"o4","caption":"Black coat, chocolate sweater and boots","pole":"tonal_column","items":["#26·03","#110·32","#487·32","#297·09"],"day":"The dark wool coat anchors the outfit for a serious work day, with matching layers underneath ensuring the look remains cohesive even when the coat is removed; the earthy tones of the boots complement the autumn season perfectly.","deliberate":[{"item":"#26·03","why":"The straight-cut wool coat provides a clean line that flatters her body shape while offering warmth for cooler autumn weather, and its length creates a strong vertical column.","finding":"f-o4-1"},{"item":"#110·32","why":"I chose the chocolate sweater to provide a warm middle ground between the black coat and boots, creating a tonal column that avoids a harsh break in color while adding richness.","finding":"f-o4-6"},{"item":"#297·09","why":"Caramel uggs soften the heavy dark layers and provide warmth for autumn weather while maintaining a professional appearance.","finding":"f-o4-4"}]}],"needed":[{"kind":"shoes","description":"I replaced the black pumps in outfit o6 with ginger heeled sandals (#159·02) because flats cut the leg line, and I need a pair that lifts the hem and acts as the accent while ensuring comfort.","type":"heeled_sandals","color":"ginger","fabric":"leather"},{"kind":"bag","description":"I replaced the large leather crossbody in outfit o7 with a medium-format bag to fix the 'bag format at scale edge' finding, ensuring the rest of the calm outfit is not upstaged.","type":"crossbody_bag","color":"brown","fabric":"leather"},{"kind":"shoes","description":"I need to replace the high-cut boots in outfit o8 with a lower-cut or nude-edge pair to close the skin band and ensure the leg line continues smoothly.","type":"boots","color":"nude","fabric":"suede"}]}
